name: Tasikmalaya

portalsFound.observation: BIG Satu Peta public MapServer; Jawa Barat sublayer 21 is queryable but has no polygons near Tasikmalaya (see requests).
City government site reachable (HTTP 200 HTML); no parcel service found on landing page.
ATR/BPN BHUMI map (HTTP 200 HTML); parcel retrieval token-gated per Jakarta research, not open.
ArcGIS Online search for Tasikmalaya parcels returned only landslide-hazard maps, no parcel layers.

requests.url: https://kspservices.big.go.id/satupeta/rest/services/PUBLIK/PERIZINAN_DAN_PERTANAHAN/MapServer/21 (returnCountOnly, envelopes 0.06 to 0.6 deg wide centred -7.33,108.22 and shifted variants)
requests.assessment: 0 polygons within about 33 km of Tasikmalaya; polygons exist further away (e.g. 4,300-5,900 in 0.4-0.8 deg boxes to the east, north and west), so this layer does not cover the city

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Jawa Barat province land-rights layer (sparse subset)

remainingUncertainty: Layer is a sparse subset of Jawa Barat; the city may be added later or held only in ATR/BPN's token-gated system. Absence here is not proof no open source exists.
nextStep: Re-test the Satu Peta layer periodically; look for a Tasikmalaya/Jabar geoportal (Jabar Satu Peta) with a public parcel layer.
